messages:
marta_cs: Quick heads-up — prepping QBR for AcroHealth next Tue. Need a concise spend readout & forecast + onboarding usage notes. Can folks drop data + recommended ask list? :eyes:
raj_finops: Uploaded forecast CSV to drive: https://redwood/drive/acro-forecast.csv. Key callouts: 30% MoM embed growth, possible token spike from onboarding flows. Will paste quick numbers if needed.
liam_onboard: FYI, we onboarded 4 power users last week, several using embed-heavy pipelines. Saw 2.8x embed calls for first 48h. Might be why spike.
kevin_sales: Renewal flag: account on enterprise E, renews in 45 days. They're happy but cost is top concern. Need mitigations to show runway.
sara_product: Can we prepare a short enablement playbook for them — 3 actions: lower context length, enable caching, batch suggestions. I can draft bullets.
raj_finops: Quick snippet of forecast query:
```
SELECT date, tokens_sum FROM usage
WHERE account='acro' AND date >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
```
Expecting projected monthly burn ~$18k unless we apply caching.
infra-bot: Alert: account acro-health crossed 80% of credits threshold at 1718256000 — automated throttle will kick at 90%. :warning:
marta_cs: ok noted. Can someone own a one-pager with: current burn, 30/60/90 day forecast, top drivers, recommended mitigations, and an ask for sales (discount/retainer)? Target: 2 slides no more.
liam_onboard: I'll pull onboarding session logs + sample prompts. Will include median prompt length + top 10 templates.
raj_finops: I'll model 3 scenarios (status quo, caching applied, cadence + quantization). ETA EOD today.
kevin_sales: I'll draft renewal framing and propose a pilot retainer & cost-smoothing. Ping me for numbers.
sara_product: I'll make the enablement 1-pager and a short checklist for the CS team.
marta_cs: owners: liam (usage & prompts), raj (forecasts & scenarios), sara (enablement doc), kevin (renewal ask). I'll consolidate into the QBR deck. Meeting invite to follow. Thanks :raised_hands:
raj_finops: quick ask — need list of any long-context models they use (LLM ids). If you have model names, drop here.
liam_onboard: they use gpt-4x-large and rdx-embed-v2 in prod. also a legacy open model for dev.
kevin_sales: also confirm if embeddings are in batch pipeline or sync calls — that changes mitigation.
marta_cs: noted. If infra team can hold off throttle until we patch caching, we can avoid a bad experience. @infra-bot can we have a temporary soft-limit tweak?
infra-bot: Temp policy: can raise soft threshold to 92% for acro-health upon owner request, but must set auto-notify at 88% and require manual rollback after patch. Admin action requested by marta_cs.
marta_cs: requesting admin action now. tagging infra-admin to approve. thanks all — i'll update thread with deck link later.
